dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures on a charcoal-grey background. Perimeters exhibit irregular, non-uniform edges with a clear luminance gradient transition from a dark exterior to a light interior, most distinct in the mid-flank and posterior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of asymmetrical, solid high-intensity pixel clusters located primarily along the upper dorsal ridge and the neck region, where individual rings coalesce into solid-tone patches lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the five most distinct annuli on the lateral flank form an irregular, elongated pentagonal spatial relationship. A cluster of three smaller rings near the caudal transition forms a scalene triangle.
